text: The 2021 tree-cover loss within the asset was detected by the Hansen Global Forest Change (GFC) dataset, specifically version GFC-2025-v1.13. This dataset identified a tree-cover loss of approximately 81.3 hectares in the year 2021. The observation was corroborated by the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 (GFC2020) dataset, which agreed on 98% of the event area. The loss was within a planted forest context, primarily affecting Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda species.
